newsitem.title: UK: Hays extends losses amid cautious comment.
newsitem.headline: Hays extends losses amid cautious comment.

text.p: Shares in business services group Hays Plc dropped to a near four-month low on Tuesday, extending Monday's losses amid cautious press and analyst comment following yesterday's results.

A report in the Financial Times said the stock had also been unsettled by comparisons of its stock market rating with the takeover multiple of recruitment group Michael Page Plc, target of a bid by Interim Services Inc.
The stock was down 17-1/2p at 519-1/2 by 1153 GMT, after earlier dropping as low as 515p, its lowest since November last year.
